name: SAKANA
source: As his second year of college begins, Kobayakawa Makoto drifts through the same monotonous days — attending classes, hanging out with friends, and wasting time — without purpose or fulfillment. He idly wonders if this empty routine even counts as living, yet remains unaware of any need for change. But everything shifts when he encounters an autumn miracle that will alter his life forever.
